source: deterministic exact pair metrics + V6 dynamic_attrition; no Monte-Carlo at runtime

features.log_dynamic_first_party_over_enemy_loss_: ln(first party loss time / first enemy loss time), missing loss mapped past horizon
features.log_enemy_pair_min_actions_to_ko: ln(min expected actions-to-KO among individual enemy->PC pairs)
features.dynamic_net_kill_fraction_enemy_minus_pa: enemy kill fraction - party kill fraction
features.log_focus_kill_rate_ratio_enemy_over_par: ln(enemy fastest focus-KO rate / party fastest focus-KO rate)
features.log_body_sum_ratio_enemy_over_party: ln(total enemy Body / total party Body)
features.log_dynamic_action_ratio_enemy_over_part: ln(enemy action integral / party action integral)
features.log1p_enemy_pressure_top1: ln(1 + max enemy single-actor pressure against its best PC target)
features.log_party_pair_min_actions_to_ko: ln(min expected actions-to-KO among individual PC->enemy pairs)
features.enemy_pressure_top1_share: highest enemy pressure / total enemy pressure
features.party_pressure_top1_share: highest PC pressure / total party pressure
features.log1p_enemy_pressure_top2_sum: ln(1 + sum of two highest enemy single-actor pressures)
features.log_enemy_focus_ttk_min: ln(min focus-TTK when party focuses each enemy)
features.party_pair_max_p_body_damage: max probability of body damage among PC->enemy pairs

note: Only the listed selected physical features are required by the V15 runtime heads. Auxiliary heads are constrained not to expand this contract.
